name: C++ 9 — Practice Lab (Constructors, Valid Initial State and Composition)
description: Guided learner workspace for the ninth lab of a beginner C++ course (3×45 min) on constructors, a valid initial state, cooperating classes and composition. First block — fundamentals: a competitor object created three ways (G09_01), brightness with the conditional operator, default state and modification (G09_02), a parcel and a separate fee calculator as two cooperating classes (G09_03), a results sheet with an object array and composition (G09_04). Second block — project: the theatre ticket office (P09_jegypenztar.cpp) built up in six steps, P1–P6 (creating tickets with a valid initial state, an empty box office and adding one ticket, rejecting a double booking, taking a ticket back and closing the gap by moving elements left, listing and the current revenue, then a summary returned as text through cooperating library classes). Third block — summary test: 20 fixed questions (T1 10 multiple-choice, T2 5 output prediction and 5 debugging) with feedback. Before every part the tutor shows a short analogous sample from the EXAMPLES.md collection; the learner writes, saves, compiles and runs the code (RUN button or g++ -std=c++20), and progress is tracked in PROGRESS.json. No homework and no separate extra exercise set.
